question: Where is restaurant located within 110 kilometers in the forward direction toward the Last House on Mulholland, Los Angeles, CA from Hungry Valley SVRA, Gorman, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.871038 34.791936)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.320457 34.131243)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.871038 34.791936)',4326)::geography, 110000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.871038 34.791936)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
